game.title: Final Fantasy XV
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG in which Noctis and his three companions travel by car across the world of Eos, from Square Enix, released 2016-11-29. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genre: RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Noctis and his friends leave the capital and travel the world. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Road Trip, Chocobos and Hobbies
chapters.summary: Driving the Regalia, riding and raising chocobos, test drives, fishing, survival, photography, cooking and JUSTICE MONSTERS FIVE.

chapters.title: Combat, Magic and Abilities
chapters.summary: Warping, link-strikes, ally commands, the Armiger, spellcraft, summons, ability nodes and weapon slots.

chapters.title: Sidequests, Hunts and Discoveries
chapters.summary: Sidequests, hunts, documents and filling the Datalog.

chapters.title: Episode Gladiolus (likely): Trials and Score Attack
chapters.summary: A run of trials with Cor, columns, Score Attack and a tortoise to topple. Which episode this block belongs to is inferred, not stated.

chapters.title: Episode Prompto
chapters.summary: Stealth, crackshots, battle selfies, time trials and the kaiser behemoth.

chapters.title: Episode Ignis (likely): Spelldaggers
chapters.summary: Spelldaggers, counterstrikes and Total Clarity. The episode name is inferred, not stated.

chapters.title: Comrades (multiplayer)
chapters.summary: Powering Lestallum, Royal Sigils, high-level weapons, the Crow's Nest Diner and the Comrades quest.

chapters.title: Episode Ardyn (likely)
chapters.summary: A final block of hidden achievements at the end of the list. Spoiler-guarded; the episode name is inferred, not stated.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Final Fantasy XV" or "Final Fantasy 15", and a StrategyWiki search for "Final Fantasy XV" returned nothing. finalfantasy.fandom.com answers the API, with 500 or more linked pages (the link list was cut off at 500), including "Final Fantasy XV: Episode Gladiolus", "Final Fantasy XV: Episode Prompto", "Final Fantasy XV: Episode Ignis", "Final Fantasy XV: Episode Ardyn" and "Final Fantasy XV: Comrades"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app is FINAL FANTASY XV WINDOWS EDITION (637650); its schema gives no game name. RAWG lists a playtime of only 5 hours, which looks low. 41 of 97 Steam achievements are hidden, and hidden ones carry no description. Only Episode Prompto and Comrades are named in achievement text; the Gladiolus, Ignis and Ardyn chapters are inferred from schema position (blocks 50 to 57, 74 to 77 and 91 to 97) plus the Fandom page names, and need checking. Hidden achievements inside those blocks were placed by position. The other hidden ones (the 16 story ones at the top, plus "Regalia Pilot", "Faithful Heir", "Immortal Photobomb", "Love Turned Tragic", "Another Path", "A New Protagonist", "Maiden Voyage", "Narwhal Watching", "The Power Within", "Tri-Headed Triumph" and "Through the Dimensional Rift") sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder; several are probably side content or belong to an episode.
